name: INTOO
business_model: per-program fee; US list prices from $600 (3-month) to $3750 (6-month), volume and custom quotes by call
notes: Outplacement and career development firm for employers, not a job board. The pricing page shows four USD amounts from $600 to $3750 and offers custom quotes for other options. No headquarters, language selector, API, partner program or job ingest method was found. The homepage line 'Countries supported in 40+ languages' describes coaching services, not site languages.

review.note: About page states it is a Gi Group Holding company and pricing page gives per-program rates; no headquarters, API or partner program stated.
